steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each audit is placed in the cycle by its due date.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 audit is more than 30 days overdue

findings.title: Process with no audit in the cycle
findings.fix: Add the process to the cycle

outcome.notChecked: The quality of each audit; processes not in the programme.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.

[low] audit-q4-it.md:26  Process with no audit in the cycle.

Not checked: The quality of each audit; processes not in the programme.
pros: Checks an audit overdue by more than 30 days, a process with no audit in the cycle, and an auditor who audited their own process.
cons: Not checked: The quality of each audit; processes not in the programme.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-qual-internal-audit-schedule skill on the records for this review.
